tools.name: get_cycle_phase
tools.title: Get cycle phase
tools.description: Compute the current menstrual cycle phase, day of cycle, next period date, and fertile window from a last-period-start date and cycle length. Pure computation — no user data is stored.

lastPeriodStart.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the first day of the most recent period.

cycleLength.description: Average cycle length in days (typical 21-35, default 28).

periodLength.description: Average period length in days (typical 3-7, default 5).

today.description: Optional ISO date to compute for (defaults to today).

tools.name: affirmation_of_the_day
tools.title: Affirmation of the day
tools.description: Return today's Sakhi Cycle affirmation — a short, warm daily message for menstrual wellness.

tools.name: list_period_products
tools.title: List period products
tools.description: List common menstrual products with pros, cons, and who they suit best. Optionally filter by product id.

id.description: Optional product id: pads, tampons, cup, disc, or period-underwear.
